newsitem.title: GERMANY: AMB non-life unit sees stable 96 earnings.
newsitem.headline: AMB non-life unit sees stable 96 earnings.

text.p: Aachener und Muenchener Versicherungs AG, the non-life insurance unit of Germany's Aachener und Muenchener Beteiligungs AG, on Wednesday repeated its forecast for steady earnings this year.

Board member Gerhard Guntermann told an analysts' conference he expected net profit this year to at least match the "good level" of 47.1 million marks achieved in 1995, which would allow an unchanged dividend payout of 25 percent.
Guntermann said he was satisfied overall with the unit's performance this year and that gross premium income should advance around one percent to around 1.98 billion marks.

The trend for declining claims had generally continued although heavy claims in industrial fire insurance and increased reserves in some areas would send claims spending up three percent to around 1.3 billion marks by year-end.
The company was also likely to narrow its underwriting loss to 42 million marks from 48.3 million marks last year.
AMV posted a rise of 0.6 percent in first-half premiums and forecast unchanged earnings for the full year.
